project.name: still_life_cycle_example
project.description: Three painterly table arrangements forming a closed visual loop.

mainframes.prompt: Painterly still life on a dark walnut table: three green pears beside a low hammered copper bowl, folded umber linen, deep olive wall, soft northern window light from the left, restrained seventeenth-century oil-painting composition, visible brushwork

Painterly still life on the same dark walnut table: five pale pink tulips in a blue-and-white porcelain vase, folded cream linen, muted slate wall, soft northern window light from the left, restrained oil-painting composition, visible brushwork

Painterly still life on the same dark walnut table: four yellow lemons beside a small tarnished silver ewer, folded blue-gray linen, smoky charcoal wall, soft northern window light from the left, restrained oil-painting composition, visible brushwork
